And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king
Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance
And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me

TRAIN.title: Train
TRAIN.hbm: Trained, instructed, trained servant, tried, experienced.
refs: he armed his trained servants, born in his own house

DRAW.title: Draw
refs: and which hath not drawn in the yoke
Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity
Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him
and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh

LEAD.title: Lead
refs: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat
take him, and lead him away safely

CONSUME.title: Consume
refs: until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai
Therefore their days did he consume in vanity
and consume them, even as Elias did?
take heed that ye be not consumed one of another

BREATHE.title: Breathe
BREATHE.gkm: To breathe upon, to breathe into.
BREATHE.hbm: Breath, breath of life; the spirit of life.
refs: and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD
he that giveth breath unto the people upon it
alt: I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live
and breathe upon these slain, that they may live
he breathed on them, and saith unto them
seeing he giveth to all life, and breath
All scripture is given by inspiration of God
All in whose nostrils was the breath of life
and the breath of all mankind
and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth

OBEY.title: Obey
refs: if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God
they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me
that even the wind and the sea obey him?
as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only

SHINE.title: Shine
SHINE.hbm: To be or become light, shine.
refs: He maketh a path to shine after him
Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes
And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not
as unto a light that shineth in a dark place

VOW.title: Vow
refs: or a sacrifice in performing a vow
When thou shalt vow a vow unto the LORD thy God
having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow
We have four men which have a vow on them

GRANT.title: Grant
refs: behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants
That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory
Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life
To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne

OVERTAKE.title: Overtake
OVERTAKE.hbm: To reach, overtake, take hold upon.
refs: I will overtake, I will divide the spoil
pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them
that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee
neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light

LISTEN.title: Listen
LISTEN.gkm: To hear, to listen, to heed.
LISTEN.hbm: To hear, to listen, to obey.
refs: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD
for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place
hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD
Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates
alt: Incline your ear, hear, and your soul shall live
This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God
let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak
Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father
And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear
let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches

LAUNCH.title: Launch
refs: Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth
we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia
and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos
And when we had launched from thence

RECEIVE.title: Receive
refs: if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee
which I have received of the Lord Jesus

OBSERVE.title: Observe
OBSERVE.gkm: To watch over, guard, keep, preserve.
OBSERVE.hbm: To keep, guard, observe, give heed.
refs: shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season
which ye shall command your children to observe to do
All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe
Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you

EXALT.title: Exalt
EXALT.hbm: To rise, rise up, be high, be lofty, be exalted.
refs: which is exalted above all blessing and praise
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill
And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased
Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted

HONOUR.title: Honour
refs: and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead
and in her left hand riches and honour
of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour
thou crownedst him with glory and honour

MARVEL.title: Marvel
refs: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again
I have done one work, and ye all marvel
and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel
Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you

HONOR.title: Honor
HONOR.gkm: To honor, value, to esteem, prize.
HONOR.hbm: To honor, glorify; to be weighty.
refs: Honour thy father and thy mother
Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour
Honour the LORD with thy substance
alt: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life
where is mine honour? and if I be a master
if any man serve me, him will my Father honour
Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king
be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen

BATHE.title: Bathe
refs: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits
ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath
and twenty thousand baths of wine
The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure

DEDICATE.title: Dedicate
refs: each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar

RULE.title: Rule
refs: and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon
but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn
and they that hated them ruled over them

ROLL.title: Roll
refs: and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth
Thou hast burned this roll, saying
and came and rolled back the stone from the door
they saw that the stone was rolled away

STRENGTHEN.title: Strengthen
STRENGTHEN.gkm: To fix, set fast, make fast.
refs: strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest
and he shall strengthen your heart
and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren
make you perfect, strengthen, settle you

CLEAVE.title: Cleave
refs: and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him
My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh
and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you

SUSTAIN.title: Sustain
refs: I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee
forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness
The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity

LOOSE.title: Loose
refs: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me
neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed
and the string of his tongue was loosed
Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death

EDIFY.title: Edify
refs: that the church may receive edifying
seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church
maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love

REDEEM.title: Redeem
refs: And if he be not redeemed in these years
and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel
and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred
which were redeemed from the earth

ENJOY.title: Enjoy
ENJOY.gkm: To enjoy, to benefit, to take pleasure.
ENJOY.hbm: To rejoice, be glad, to take delight.
refs: and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto
for the joy of the LORD is your strength
alt: and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God
and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God
than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry
who giveth us richly all things to enjoy
Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy
for God had made them rejoice with great joy

CARE.title: Care
CARE.hbm: To lift, bear up, carry, take.
refs: Master, carest thou not that we perish?
because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep
and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men
Art thou called being a servant? care not for it

GROW.title: Grow
GROW.hbm: To grow, become great, to magnify.
refs: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon
he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon
and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall
alt: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature
may grow up into him in all things, which is the head
and increasing in the knowledge of God
desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby
because that your faith groweth exceedingly
and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon

STAY.title: Stay
STAY.hbm: To lean on, trust in, support.
refs: shall no more again stay upon him that smote them
and stay on horses, and trust in chariots
and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon

STUDY.title: Study
STUDY.gkm: To love or seek after honour, hence, to be ambitious, emulous.
refs: and much study is a weariness of the flesh
And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business

EAT.title: Eat
EAT.hbm: To eat, devour, burn up, feed.
refs: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days
but he refused to eat. And Amnon said
so that they could not so much as eat bread
but because ye did eat of the loaves

DIVIDE.title: Divide
DIVIDE.hbm: To divide, share, plunder, allot, apportion, assign.
refs: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes
I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth
he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand
